item.title: In midst of pandemic, drugmakers raise prices on hundreds of prescription drugs
item.description: So far this month, drugmakers have hiked prices on 636 drugs, according to research by GoodRx, which tracks prescription drug prices and offer a mobile app to help consumers find the lowest prices on hundreds of drugs. item.title: Fishers-based pajama company wins $50,000 prize on new Bloomberg TV competition
item.description: Laura Musall, of Fishers, appeared on the debut episode of 2 Minute Drill Friday and took first place for the pitch she gave about the line of breathable pajamas she co-created with Mindy Ford, of Lebanon. item.title: Bill would require nursing homes to allow ‘compassionate care’ visits during pandemic
item.description: The legislation, Senate Bill 202, would allow designated family members to visit residents under end-of-life and other serious circumstances. item.title: Developer plans new retail center on Michigan Road in Carmel
item.description: Preliminary site plans show an 11,000-square-foot, multi-tenant building with space for six new businesses on the southern portion of the property and a standalone 2,000-square-foot restaurant building to the north—each with their own drive-thrus. item.title: The number of new COVID cases continues to drop in Indiana
item.description: Statewide hospitalizations due to COVID-19 dropped to 2,118 on Friday from 2,134 on Thursday. The high mark was 3,460, set on Nov. 30. The post The number of new COVID cases continues to drop in Indiana appeared first on Indianapolis Business Journal.
